## v2.2.2

JellyPilot 2.2.2 adds per-series Intro Skipper preferences, chapter-aware playback controls, richer media details, and smoother desktop interactions. It also consolidates playback and item-action state handling without changing the established slider and keyboard behavior.

### Highlights
- **Per-series Intro Skipper preferences**: desktop choices are saved per profile and series across episodes and restarts. Automatic / Manual replaces the previous Off choice; manual skips apply to the current range visit and become available again after re-entry.
- **Chapter-aware player controls**: the embedded timeline shows real MPV chapter markers and available names alongside fetched intro and credit ranges. When the pointer leaves the controls, a read-only edge timeline appears, hides after three seconds during playback, and stays visible while paused.
- **Richer media details**: movie and episode pages show media specifications and bounded audio/subtitle track popovers. Episode series names open the parent series while preserving browsing history and the originating season when available.
- **Desktop motion and background residency**: shared interruptible motion respects reduced-motion preferences. With the tray initialized, closing the window keeps JellyPilot running; embedded playback pauses, while External MPV continues. Explicit Quit still shuts down.

### Improvements and fixes
- Unified Favorite, watched-state, and local Watchlist write coordination. Same-item controls share pending state, confirmed changes survive navigation, and stale reads cannot undo accepted changes.
- Centralized playback command execution and seek/volume adjustment ownership, preserving release-to-commit, cancelled-drag behavior, queued adjustments, and existing feedback.
- Fixed saved-profile handling for v3 storage, preserving profile metadata and unsupported-provider accounts during supported-account writes while retaining legacy readability and preventing session-incarnation reuse after sign-out.
- Refined account and playback interface wording and improved narrow detail-page layouts.
- Prevented presses dismissing the player Information popover from also activating underlying controls, and prevented detail track popovers from stretching during dismissal.

### Experimental HDR
Linux Wayland Embedded MPV Playback adds experimental HDR10 output with Auto / On / Off selection, decoded PQ/HLG detection, a 203-nit UI reference white, and SDR fallback when unsupported. Broader display-chain compatibility and automatic-transition visual acceptance remain under validation; this is not a general HDR compatibility guarantee.

### Platform notes
- Linux continues to default to Embedded MPV Playback. Windows and macOS continue to default to External MPV Playback.
- Windows embedded runtime DLLs remain unsigned and may be blocked by Smart App Control. This release does not resolve that signing limitation.
- Android remains a separate risk bring-up, not a complete client or an artifact in this desktop release.
